class.name: ResonanceCodaEventEmitter
class.brief_description: Experimental Coda event emitter with Resonance spatial sync. API subject to change.
class.description: Experimental and subject to change. Plays a Nexus Coda event at this node's transform and links it to Steam Audio simulation. Requires the [code]Coda[/code] autoload and [ResonanceRuntime] with [member ResonanceRuntime.coda_bridge_enabled] (active bridge from [method ResonanceRuntime.get_coda_bridge]). [method play_event] passes this node's path as [code]_coda_spatial_emitter[/code] so the Coda bridge can drive occlusion on the voice.

members.member: Coda event path used by [method play_event] when calling [code]Coda.play[/code]. Default [code]event:/[/code].
When true, calls [method play_event] once when the node becomes ready in play mode (deferred, after the bridge is resolved). Default false.
Source radius in meters (inspector range 0.01 to 100). Reserved for future per-source radius overrides; spatial sync today uses this node's transform only.

method.name: play_event
method.description: Starts Coda playback at [member event_path]. Merges [param params] with [code]_coda_spatial_emitter[/code] set to this node's path for bridge occlusion. Stops any voice already playing on this emitter first. Returns the Coda voice handle, or null if the Coda autoload or bridge is missing.

method.name: stop_event
method.description: Stops the active voice on this emitter. [param fade_ms] is the fade-out length in milliseconds (0 = immediate). No effect if nothing is playing.

method.name: set_event_parameter
method.description: Sets a Coda event parameter on the active voice ([param name_or_id], [param value]). No effect if [method play_event] has not started a voice or it was already stopped.
